description: Subreddit card — id (t5_…), members, activeUsers, rules[], ISO createdAt, nsfw/type. Flat 1 credit. Costs 1 credit. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

url.description: Subreddit URL, r/name, or bare name (case-insensitive), e.g. r/technology or AskReddit. The URL platform must match this endpoint's platform. Do not pass cross-platform URLs, e.g. YouTube to TikTok, Instagram to Facebook, LinkedIn to X/Twitter, or Pinterest to Rumble.

name: reddit_subreddit_details
title: Reddit Subreddit Details
